description.value:
Trigger Your turn begins.

Requirement You are at or below half your maximum Hit Points and above 0.

Duration constant

At the start of each of your turns, if you are at or below half your maximum Hit Points, regain Hit Points equal to your level. This does not function if you are at 0 Hit Points.

cinderfall.incomplete: The regeneration itself matches pf2e's real FastHealing rule element (confirmed real minimal use: pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/archetype/wizard/grand-medics-mask.json, [{"key": "FastHealing", "value": 5}]), and its value field accepts a roll-data formula like @actor.level (confirmed via pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/fast-healing.ts, ResolvableValueField, and the runtime's own "value must be a number or a roll formula" check). But this card's entire effect is conditioned on "if at or below half max HP," and no generic, engine-wide roll option for "this actor is at or below half HP" was found anywhere in pf2e-source -- only item-specific custom flags exist for that shape (e.g. class-features/barrows-edge.json's own "barrows-edge:target-below-half", set by that card's own separate rule element, for a different creature's HP, not a generic self-HP flag). Shipping FastHealing without the conditional would misrepresent the card as unconditional regeneration -- not shipped.
